d:
Navratri vrat mein sabudana se alag kuch? Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani ki Samak Cubes recipe – bina tel ke bhi kurkure!
Samak chawal aur aloo se bane crispy cubes, saath mein dry fruit energy shake. Ek baar banao, 2-3 din khao – vrat mein bhi, aur vrat ke bina bhi.
Samak (bhagar) ke cubes jo bahar se crispy aur andar se soft bante hain
Air fryer, shallow fry ya deep fry – teeno tareeke
Fridge ya freezer mein store karke 2-3 din tak khaayein
Dry fruit banana shake jo office bottle mein bhi le jaa sakte hain
Comment karein – aapke yahan samak ko kya kehte hain: bhagar, samvat ya sama?
